item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 25/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, broad bands of clouds will cover southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea. An intense northeast monsoon is expected to reach Guangdong over the weekend. Temperatures will fall appreciably over the region. Under the influence of the following replenishment of the monsoon, the weather will remain rather cool over the region during the Lunar New Year holidays.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with sunny intervals. One or two rain patches at night.
